title: Nhận định Bờ Biển Ngà vs Ecuador — World Cup 2026

scenes.subjectHint: Hook đối đầu — Kessie (Bờ Biển Ngà) vs Caicedo (Ecuador) · dự đoán hòa 1-1

Behind him, a stylized vivid-orange graphic backdrop with a huge faint FIF elephant crest watermark and radiating light rays. Right half: Moises Caicedo, the Ecuadorian defensive midfielder for the Ecuador national team, in a bright yellow Ecuador home kit with the FEF federation crest clearly visible on the chest, mirroring a composed commanding hero pose. Behind him, a stylized golden-yellow graphic backdrop with a huge faint FEF crest watermark and radiating light rays. Down the centre seam: a diagonal lightning-burst slash separator with dramatic energy glow, the FIFA World Cup trophy glowing as a stylized golden graphic accent between them. Vibrant saturated palette per side, very high contrast, glossy graphic-design finish. Stylized like a World Cup matchday promotional poster. Both national-team crests visible on the jerseys, no on-image text or captions, no scoreboard graphics.
